patch_list: Bypasses PairIP signature and Google Play license checks. It also bypasses PairIP's encrypted-key import bootstrap, neutralizes its protected native logger, restores the game library's PairIP-encrypted native data, disables broken AndroidX…

Changes the manifest package and package-derived authorities/permissions so Zombie Catchers Morphe can install beside the original. Play Games, Firebase auth, store updates, and server checks can still reject the renamed and re-signed buil…

Skips Google Play Billing and exposes the app's product list at zero price. Buying an item sends a synthetic purchase receipt through Zombie Catchers' own native purchaseResult success callback, and the native server receipt check is force…

Disables AppLovin MAX initialization, banners, and real ad playback. Interstitial requests complete immediately. Rewarded requests call the game's native successful completion callback so reward-gated actions can still grant their reward.…

Makes the game always read 1,342,177,279 coins and plutonium. Both are 32-bit values, so this is near the maximum while leaving room for rewards to be added without overflowing. Spending never lowers the balance. Use a throwaway account.
